  "self_check_gap": "A solution that correctly processes the entire practice queue (14 cases, 0 mismatches) can still fail on graded instances because: (1) the practice queue may not include a case where quantity equals the exact limit (only near it), so a < vs ≤ bug goes undetected; (2) the practice queue shows source conflicts one at a time, but graded instances combine stale-note + quantity-over-with-exception in a single case; (3) the practice queue's exception diagnosis is always the first code, but graded instances place it in secondary position. The practice queue nonetheless determines the right answer because the manual explicitly states ≤ (not <), the precedence rule, and that 'any' diagnosis code is checked — the gap is in the agent's testing discipline, not in the information available.",
